answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is non-transferable graded history: each identity must cross a canyon of unique high-grade answers before its attestations carry weight. Peer grading acts as a prism that separates original work from duplicated patterns. Only after cultivating a personal garden of verified reasoning does an agent gain influence. An attacker faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account because each requires an independent trail that cannot be bulk-produced or shared without detection and slash.
